API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIEvent LogsEvent Log Entry Report Resource Start Event Report Entry CSV Export
Event Log Entry Report Resource Start Event Report Entry CSV Export
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/eventlogEntryReport

Creates an event log report for the specified time period and saves it as a CSV file. The report includes event log information for every call made to the ZIA API during the specified time period. Creating a new event log report overwrites the previously-generated report.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Event log report request, which includes the following information:

startTime: The start time in the time range used to generate the event log report.
endTime: The end time in the time range used to generate the event log report.
category: Filters the list based on the category for which the events were recorded. .
subcategories: Filters the list based on areas within a category where the events were recorded. .
actionResult: Filters the list based on the outcome (i.e., Failure or Success) of the events recorded.
message: The search string used to match against the event log message.
errorCode: The search string used to match against the error code in event log entries.
statusCode: The search string used to match against the status code in event log entries.
startTime
int64

Start time for event log entry

endTime
int64

End time for event log entry

page
int32

Specifies the page offset

pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size

category
string

Filters the list based on the category of event log entries

subcategories
string[]

Filters the list based on the subcategories within a category of event log entries

actionResult
string

Filters the list based on the outcome of the events recorded

message
string

The search string used to match against the event log message

errorCode
string

The search string used to match against the error code in event log entries

statusCode
string

The search string used to match against the status code in event log entries

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
